core.title: Explore Hardware Tubular Replacement  Latch, AHI-LUX-LATCH

text.description_html:
AHI-LUX-LATCH Explore Hardware Tubular Replacement Latch

This tubular latch is specifically for AHI Explore Hardware Lever and Knob Sets

It is available for 2 3/8" or 2 3/4" backsets. For both Passage and Privacy functions.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.

To determine Backset: Measure from the center of the backplate or bore hole, to the edge of the door.
